200.description:
Registry-wide value statistics for up to 20 field pieces (GET /api/v2/stats/field/values): for enums and strings the distinct values with study counts, for dates and integers min/max, for booleans true/false counts, plus how many studies lack the field. Use it to learn the exact enum values (OverallStatus, Phase, StudyType, DateType, ...) accepted by search filters and Essie expressions.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `fields` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | string | Dotted path of the field in the study record. |
| `missing_studies_count` | number |  |
| `piece` | string |  |
| `stats` | object | Type-specific statistics as returned: min/max/formats for DATE, min/max/avg for INTEGER and NUMBER, longest for STRING, trueCount/falseCount for BOOLEAN. Empty for ENUM. |
| `top_values` | object[] | ENUM and STRING fields only; the registry returns up to 250 values, most frequent first. |
| `type` | string | ENUM, STRING, DATE, INTEGER, NUMBER or BOOLEAN. |
| `unique_values_count` | number | ENUM and STRING fields only. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Discover NCT numbers for a topic before calling study or study_dates; list trials by sponsor, status or location.

advanced_filter.description: Essie filter expression applied after the query (filter.advanced), e.g. AREA[StartDateType]ESTIMATED.

agg_filters.description: Facet filters as the site encodes them (aggFilters), e.g. "phase:3,status:rec". Pattern: ^[a-zA-Z]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_ ]+(,[a-zA-Z]+:[a-zA-Z0-9_ ]+)*$.

condition.description: Condition or disease (query.cond), e.g. "Breast Cancer". Essie syntax allowed.

location.description: Location terms: city, state, country or facility (query.locn), e.g. "Boston".

near.description: Only studies with a site within the radius of the coordinate (filter.geo=distance(lat,lon,radius)).

page_size.description:
Studies per page (the API accepts up to 1000; capped at 100 here).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 10.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous page. Send the same query parameters again. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.

sort.description: Sort by a field piece with optional direction, e.g. "LastUpdatePostDate:desc", or "@relevance" (default when a query is given). Pattern: ^(@relevance|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(:(asc|desc))?)$.

status.description: Overall status filter (filter.overallStatus); any of the listed values matches.

term.description: Other terms searched across the record (query.term). Accepts Essie expressions such as AREA[StartDate]RANGE[2025-01-01,MAX].

title.description: Words in the brief or official title, or acronym (query.titles).

200.description:
Search the registry (GET /api/v2/studies). Filter by condition, intervention, sponsor, location, title, free-text Essie expression, overall status, distance from a coordinate or an advanced Essie filter. Returns one page of study summaries with raw date structs (date + ACTUAL/ESTIMATED type) and a page token for the next page. Repeat every query parameter with page_token to continue.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `studies` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acronym` | string |  |
| `brief_title` | string |  |
| `completion_date` | object | A registry date struct; null when the record (or the requested subset) has no such date. |
| `conditions` | string[] |  |
| `countries` | string[] | Distinct site countries in registry order. |
| `enrollment` | object |  |
| `has_results` | boolean |  |
| `interventions` | object[] |  |
| `last_update_post_date` | object | A registry date struct; null when the record (or the requested subset) has no such date. |
| `lead_sponsor` | object |  |
| `nct_id` | string |  |
| `official_title` | string |  |
| `overall_status` | string |  |
| `phases` | string[] | Empty for observational studies and studies without a phase. |
| `primary_completion_date` | object | A registry date struct; null when the record (or the requested subset) has no such date. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `start_date` | object | A registry date struct; null when the record (or the requested subset) has no such date. |
| `study_first_post_date` | object | A registry date struct; null when the record (or the requested subset) has no such date. |
| `study_type` | string |  |
| `why_stopped` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Raw status and date metadata for up to 200 known NCT numbers in one request (GET /api/v2/studies?filter.ids=...). Each study returns overallStatus, lastKnownStatus, whyStopped, statusVerifiedDate and the start, primary-completion, completion, first-post and last-update-post date structs with their ACTUAL or ESTIMATED type exactly as the registry states them. NCT numbers the registry does not know are listed in not_found_ids; the call fails with not_found only when none of them is known.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `studies` as the primary payload key.
